plus.injection_text:
To further strengthen the proposal, we have assembled a highly qualified team with critical roles filled by industry leaders. Dr. Palti, as the Chief Executive Officer, brings over 15 years of experience in medical device commercialization, having previously led a successful exit at MedTech Innovations, which was acquired by BioHealth Corp in 2023. Dr. Liu, our Chief Technology Officer, holds a PhD from Stanford University and has published over 10 peer-reviewed articles in leading journals such as the Journal of Medical Devices, showcasing his expertise in tumor treatment technologies. Additionally, Ms. Chen, our Chief Financial Officer, has a strong background in financial strategy, having worked at Goldman Sachs for 8 years, where she managed a portfolio of healthcare investments.

Our advisory board includes Dr. Emily Zhang, a renowned oncologist from Peking University Cancer Hospital, and Mr. John Smith, a former executive at Medtronic, who will provide invaluable insights into regulatory pathways and market entry strategies. We have established a formal governance structure that includes bi-monthly meetings to ensure alignment on project objectives and decision-making processes, with clear roles defined for each board member.

The team has a proven track record of successful project execution, having collectively launched three medical devices in the past five years, including the award-winning SmartBandage, which received FDA approval in 2022. This experience not only demonstrates our capability to navigate complex regulatory environments but also highlights our ability to deliver results on time and within budget. Furthermore, we have secured a partnership with the Shanghai Medical Association, which will facilitate access to clinical trial participants and enhance our market validation efforts.

To address potential key-person risks, we have implemented a robust succession plan that includes cross-training team members in critical roles. Each core team member has a designated backup to ensure continuity in operations. Additionally, we are actively recruiting for two additional engineers to bolster our development capacity, ensuring that we have the necessary resources to meet project milestones. This proactive approach to team composition and risk management positions us well for successful project execution and long-term sustainability in the competitive medical device market.
